fortune.source.method1: Set the day master ({{dayMaster}}) as the core and take meaning from five elements ({{element}}); if the hour pillar is used ({{hourUse}}), include it too.
fortune.source.method2: Use the local rule engine ({{engine}}) to compute the overall score, then split hexagram intent into five aspects: career, wealth, relationships, health, and mood.
